summary: Chelan County, WA DNR lookout built 1972; collapsed or toppled in 2008 on private land; an undated visitor page describes the remains.

facts.design: Wooden DNR tower, 50 ft per the register and firelookout.com (a 2008 chapter report says 60 ft)
facts.status_note: Collapsed or toppled in 2008; an undated visitor page says what remains lies in shambles on the ground

access.note: Stood on private land; a visitor page says a sign at the base named Longview Fibre Company as owner. No source says the public may enter.

visit.trail_note: Rough, rocky road reached from Colockum Pass per a visitor page, which recommends a good vehicle.

corrections.why: The register and firelookout.com both say 50 feet and built 1972. Only the 2008 chapter report says 60 feet, so the 60-foot figure is disputed rather than settled.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give 50 feet; the 2008 chapter report says 60 feet. The story uses 50 feet, the figure two sources give with the build year, and flags the dispute.
The register gives 5,200 ft (1,585 m); a visitor page gives 5,040 feet or more. The register figure is kept.

The chapter report says it collapsed. A Washington lookouts page says it was found toppled over, with leg clamps possibly loosened, and a visitor page suspects it was brought down on purpose. The story reports all three without choosing one.

notes_for_editor: Brief said the tower was 60 ft; two sources say 50 ft and the 2008 chapter report says 60 ft. The story says 50 ft and flags the dispute. Brief's access 'unknown' is now 'private' based on the 2008 report; no current owner or access policy was found in any source read. The remains description comes from an undated visitor page; no source from the last few years was read, so the present state of the site is unconfirmed. Elevation differs between sources (see resolved_conflicts).
